_comment: Packets implemented by hand in src/protocol/<state>/hand.go. The packets generator skips them even when the schema types them fully, and says so, so the hand-written version can be retired deliberately. Key: <state>/<flow>/<packet name> as in packets.json.
configuration/clientbound/minecraft:cust: the payload is the rest of the packet, keyed by channel
configuration/serverbound/minecraft:cust: the payload is the rest of the packet, keyed by channel
login/clientbound/minecraft:custom_query: the payload is the rest of the packet
login/serverbound/minecraft:custom_query: optional payload is the rest of the packet
play/clientbound/minecraft:custom_payloa: the payload is the rest of the packet, keyed by channel
play/serverbound/minecraft:custom_payloa: the payload is the rest of the packet, keyed by channel
play/clientbound/minecraft:level_chunk_w: the chunk sections are decoded into level.Chunk, which needs the dimension height
play/clientbound/minecraft:player_chat: signed chat body and the filter mask
play/clientbound/minecraft:player_info_u: entries whose parts depend on the action bit set
